content: बाणः .²1 An arrow, shaft, reed; <ls>Bṛ. Up. 3. 8. 2</ls>; धनुष्यमोघं समधत्त बाणम् <ls>Ku. 3. 66</ls>. .²2 An aim or mark for arrows. .²3 The feathered end of an arrow. .²4 The udder of a cow. .²5 The body (शरीर); ते प्रकाश्याभिवदन्ति वयमेतद्बाणमवष्टभ्य विधारयामः <ls>Praśna. Up. 2. 2</ls>. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of a demon, son of Bali; <ab>cf.</ab> उषा. .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of a celebrated poet who lived at the court of king Harṣavardhana and flourished in the first half of the seventh century; (see <ls>App. II</ls>). He is the author of कादम्बरी, हर्षचरित and of some other works; (Govardhana in his <ls>Āryā. S. 37</ls> speaks in these terms of Bāṇa:-- जाता शिखण्डिनी प्राग् यथा शिखण्डी तथावगच्छामि . प्रागल्भ्यधिकमाप्तुं वाणी बाणो बभूवेति ..; so हृदयवसतिः पञ्चबाणस्तु बाणः <ls>P. R. 1. 22</ls>). .²8 A symbolical expression for the number ‘five’. .²9 A sound, voice. .²10 Fire. .²11 Lightning. .²12 A form of Śiva. .²13 The versed sine of an arc. .{@-णः, -णा@} The hinder part or feathered end of an arrow. .{@-णः, -णा, -णम्@} a blue flowering Barleria -नीलझिण्टी (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>कोन्हांटी</ns>); अनाविलोन्मीलितबाणचक्षुषः <ls>Ki. 4. 28</ls>; <ls>Śi. 6. 46</ls>.
